I liked the model because the B-rated models have a significantly faster Auto program than the A-rated ones. The height-adjustable rack is a plus and makes it convenient. Minor details that could be improved include the quality of the upper rack (the pins seem somewhat fragile) and the somewhat awkward installation of the hose system in tight spaces (the LG installer couldn't manage it, and a specialist had to be called). A disappointing detail from LG is that their "Service Locator" website doesn't seem to be working; I already reported it, but they haven't done anything about it.
Comments (Original): [ Cómodo y silencioso ] || ---------------- || (Esta reseña se ha recibido a través de una promoción.) Se trata de un lavavajillas bastante silencioso y efectivo en el lavado. Pequeños detalles a mejorar serían la calidad de la bandeja superior (pines parecen algo delicados) y algo incómodo para instalar el sistema de mangueras en espacios apretados (el instalador de LG no pudo y fue necesario llamar a un especialista). Sentence (English): I'm leaving a review of a product I bought with my own money, paid for by my husband.
Comments (English): I'm leaving a review of a product I bought with my own money, paid for by my husband. After moving, I was using the dishwasher the previous owner left behind. I chose this model because using the 3-tier setup is convenient. I used to use a 12-place setting, but using the 14-place setting, it definitely fits more, and I love that large pots fit well in the bottom section! It's even more convenient and great that it connects with the LG ThinQ app. I recommend it!

Sentence (English): As expected from Samsung!
Comments (English): As expected from Samsung! A review of the BESPOKE countertop dishwasher, featuring both neatness and convenience (purchased with my own money). Among the three generations of my family, I have finally gotten a dishwasher. Actually, my previous dishwasher broke down, so I managed with hand washing for a while, but it was incredibly inconvenient to go without it. So, I urgently searched online and decided on the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-place setting countertop dishwasher, which I liked for both its design and features. The white color matches my kitchen interior perfectly, and although it is compact, it offers great storage capacity. A Samsung technician came, installed it neatly, and gave a friendly explanation, so I started off on a good note. There is a reason people say "Samsung service is the best." Pros: The automatic door opening feature is truly a game changer! With my old dishwasher, I had to open the door manually after the wash was finished, which was inconvenient. But with this one, the door opens slightly automatically after washing to let the steam escape, allowing for much better drying. The white BESPOKE design is clean and luxurious, so it provides a perfect interior effect no matter which kitchen you place it in. It has a baby bottle sterilization function, so it is perfect for homes with babies. Since it uses high-temperature sterilization, I felt safe washing glass bottles and baby food containers. The wine glass cleaning power is truly amazing. My husband likes having a glass of wine after work, and this time, he was so satisfied because the wine glasses sparkled like glass after washing. It is quiet and operates quietly, so I don't mind running it at night. One drawback: Since installation space is limited, you need to check the height of your kitchen countertop carefully before ordering. The internal basket configuration is a bit tight, so it is difficult to wash large pots. Overall review: Thanks to the Samsung BESPOKE dishwasher, my dishwashing stress has disappeared. The design is pretty, the functions are smart, and the cleaning power is perfect. In particular, the automatic door opening function and sterilization wash make me think, "This is definitely Samsung." It is a product that makes me feel good every time I take out clean, sparkling dishes every day. Overall rating: 5 out of 5! I am satisfied with the neatness, cleaning power, design, and functionality, and my kitchen looks much more sophisticated. To put it in one sentence, I can never go back to washing dishes by hand!
Comments (Original): 역시 삼성! 깔끔함과 편리함을 모두 갖춘 BESPOKE 카운터탑 식기세척기 후기(내돈내산)3대 이모 중 드디어 식기세척기를 들여놨어요 사실 기존에 사용하던 식세기가 고장 나서 잠시 그냥 손설거지로 버텼는데,있다가 없으니 정말 너무 불편하더라고요.그래서 급히 검색하다가 디자인과 기능 모두 마음에 드는삼성전자 BESPOKE 카운터탑 식기세척기 6인용으로 결정했습니다.화이트 컬러라 주방 인테리어랑 찰떡이고,컴팩트한 크기지만 수납력도 좋아요.삼성 기사님이 오셨는데,설치도 깔끔하게 해주시고 설명도 친절해서 기분 좋게 시작했어요.역시 “삼성 서비스”라는 말이 괜히 있는 게 아니에요.✅ 좋은 점자동 문열림 기능이 정말 신세계예요!예전 식세기는 세척이 끝나면 문을 직접 열어야 해서 불편했는데,이건 세척 후 자동으로 문이 살짝 열리며 증기가 빠져나가 건조가 훨씬 잘돼요.화이트 BESPOKE 디자인이 깔끔하고 고급스러워서어느 주방에 둬도 인테리어 효과 만점이에요.젖병 소독 기능이 있어서 아기 있는 집에도 딱이에요.고온 살균이라 유리병, 이유식 용기도 안심하고 세척할 수 있겠더라고요.와인잔 세척력이 정말 놀라워요 남편이 퇴근 후 와인 한 잔 하는 걸 좋아하는데,이번엔 세척 후 와인잔이 반짝반짝 유리처럼 빛나서너무 만족해하더라고요.소음도 적고 작동도 조용해서 밤에 돌려도 신경 안 쓰여요.⚠️ 아쉬운 점설치 공간이 한정돼 있다 보니,싱크대 상판 높이를 잘 확인하고 주문해야 해요.내부 바스켓 구성이 살짝 타이트해서큰 냄비는 세척하기 어려워요.✅ 총평삼성 BESPOKE 식기세척기 덕분에 이제 설거지 스트레스가 사라졌어요.디자인도 예쁘고, 기능은 스마트하며, 세척력까지 완벽해요.특히 자동 문열림 기능과 살균 세척은‘역시 삼성이다’ 싶게 만들어요.매일매일 깨끗하게 반짝이는 그릇들을 꺼낼 때마다 기분이 좋아지는 제품이에요 ⭐ 총평 : 5점 만점에 5점!깔끔함, 세척력, 디자인, 기능성 모두 만족스럽고주방이 훨씬 세련돼졌어요.한 줄로 표현하자면, “이젠 손설거지로 절대 못 돌아가요!”

I plan to experiment with different cycles in the future.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher last month, and since we've already done a few washes, it's time to share our experience with another LG product at home.
Comments (English): [ Better than expected ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher last month, and since we've already done a few washes, it's time to share our experience with another LG product at home. Having previously used another brand, we tried to find one with a similar tray system, and especially one without a cutlery basket, which takes up space on the lower rack. Having three trays made the transition easier, and while other brands have plastic interiors, this one is stainless steel. There are quite a few wash cycles, and you quickly learn which one is best for daily use. We haven't used the deep clean cycles or other enhancements because we haven't needed them. However, the day we start using much dirtier pots and pans, that will be the time to use these features. One advantage over our previous model is that the drying cycle used a small fan to extract hot, humid air, leaving a stuffy feeling in the kitchen. Now, when the drying cycle finishes, the door opens a few centimeters, which I think helps to complete the drying cycle without leaving condensation. the plastic containers
Comments (Original): [ Mejor de lo esperado ] || ---------------- || Compramos este lavavajillas el mes pasado, y como ya han pasado unos cuantos lavados, ya es hora de comentar la experiencia de otro producto LG en casa.Como veníamos de otra marca, intentamos encontrar el mas parecido en el sistema de bandejas, y que sobre todo no tuviese cesto para los cubiertos, que quita espacio en la bandeja inferior, al tener tres bandejas ha sido mas fácil la adaptation, así como otras marcas tienen su interior de plástico este es de acero inoxidable.Los ciclos de lavado, ques on unos cuantos, en pocos días ya sabes cual es el idóneo para el uso diario, no hemos usado los ciclos de limpieza profunda y demás mejoras, por no necesitarlos, demento, el día que se pongan ollas u otros utensilios mucho mas sucios, sera el momento de utilizar estos avances.Una ventaja con respecto al anterior, que el ciclo de secado extraía el aire caliente y húmedo con un pequeño ventilador, dejando esa sensación de bochorno en la cocina, ahora cuando acaba el secado la puerta se abre unos centímetros, con lo que creo que ayuda a cerrar el ciclo de secado sin dejar condensación en los tapers de plástico

Comments (English): [ It's easy to use and dishwashing is easy. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Today, I'm going to introduce a dishwasher with great value for money. My Dear is a company that makes good dishwashers at a great value. There are several people around me who have bought this product and are using it well. I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to buy a dishwasher but is concerned about the price. It's a product with excellent performance. I'll post a review of the My Dear 6-person automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher. Advantages of My Dear dishwasher - Automatic door opening system: After washing, the door automatically opens to release the steam inside and bring in outside air, making drying more efficient. - Hot air circulation drying: After washing, hot air of 75-80 degrees is circulated to dry powerfully. - 24-hour automatic ventilation: The interior is dried with cool air to prevent mold and odor. Mydia Dishwasher Features - Dual Installation Method: You can choose between two types: no-installation method that requires no drilling, automatic water intake method that requires no pouring, and installation water supply method that requires simple installation. - Powerful Cleaning Power: The extra-large nozzle applied to the bottom 44cm cleans every corner without any blind spots in 360 degrees. The extra-large nozzle that is twice as long further increases the cleaning power. - Dual sterilization system: UV ultraviolet sterilization and 75 degree high-temperature sterilization are performed. - Korean-style customized washing: Equipped with 5 washing courses suitable for Korean tableware. - Large-capacity dish loading: Dishes for up to 6 people can be loaded. - Automatic detergent and rinse aid injection: Detergent and rinse aid are automatically injected during washing. - Low-noise mode: Very quiet at 50-55 decibels. - Child lock: Safe to use even in homes with children. - Various positioning installations: The length of the water supply and drain pipes has been maximized, allowing installation in any space. - Stainless steel material: Stainless steel is used on the three inner sides and triple filter nets to prevent corrosion and ensure hygienic use. - 2-year free warranty: The washing pump and heating tube, which are key components, are covered by a 2-year free warranty. Mydia is a company that makes good dishwashers. Above all, it is easy to use because it has a reasonable price and smart functions. Yes. Washing dishes can cause back pain, and this product helps relieve the burden of housework for busy modern people. I hope you can relax and focus on creating good memories with your family by taking the time to relax and enjoy the comfort of housework.

Sentence (English): Don't recommend buying Westinghouse appliances if you want any sort of decent customer service.
Comments (English): Don't recommend buying Westinghouse appliances if you want any sort of decent customer service. After kitting out majority of my kitchen with Westinghouse appliances I've been extremely disappointed with the customer service provided by Westinghouse/electrolux. My dishwasher decided to malfunction two months after my warranty expired so I contacted Westinghouse directly to see if they would provide any grace period. The way Westinghouse/electrolux palmed me off was very disappointing to say the least. The customer service representative assured me there was nothing they could do as the machine is out of warranty. Although under the guidelines provided by the ACCC it is very reasonable a dishwasher should last longer than the 26 months it has been in use. I then proceed to ask if I could speak to a manager or send my case to the escalation team where I was blatantly told no.After calling back the next day I managed to file my case to the escalation team and was told I would get a call back within 48 hours. After waiting more than 48 hours I decided to chase them to be told my case had never been submitted. This is very disappointing after spending thousands of dollars on Westinghouse appliances for them to palm off loyal returning customers. I would be extremely reluctant to purchase any more Westinghouse/electrolux appliances in the future after this poor experience as I would also strongly recommend my clients as a builder to stay away from Westinghouse if they are to provide this type of service.

Sentence (English): I purchased this because I was looking for a product that fits on a countertop and is suitable for a two-person household.
Comments (English): I purchased this because I was looking for a product that fits on a countertop and is suitable for a two-person household. As for the advantages, since I bought it intending to run it frequently even with small amounts, the 30-minute rapid drying function is a significant plus. It is also relatively quiet, and I was pleased that it definitely produces cleaner and neater results than drying by hand. The downside is that I chose this model because it is a recent addition with hot air drying, and the price difference from the previous model was minimal. However, the hot air drying time takes longer than expected, and it seems I have to run it on high for a long time to achieve complete drying, so it doesn't seem to be a very useful feature. The buttons are pretty and neat, turning on with a simple press of the power button, but they are small, so it might be difficult for elderly users to see them. The water inlet hole on the countertop seems almost essential, so I think the website needs to provide a more detailed description. Before purchasing, buyers must verify the product size, whether a water inlet hole is necessary, the location of the inlet and drainage holes, the location of power outlets, and the direction in which the unit opens. In my case, it matched my expectations perfectly, and the installation took only about 20 minutes. Also, I learned during installation that if you install it to open to the left side, the dish rack (see photo) stands upright when you open it, which can be inconvenient, so please keep that in mind. Do you want to avoid washing dishes at all? NO. Do you want to install it on the countertop and run it frequently for convenience? YES. Do you have many pretty and cherished pots and dishes? NO. Do you want to wash dishes thoroughly? Even though they are precious, only the toughest ones survive? YES. After using it a few times, I realized I still had to rinse them roughly before putting them in, so it wasn't completely convenient. However, seeing the dishes looking neater and cleaner than when washed by hand made me feel so good that I think I made the right decision to install it. I hadn't given it much thought about detergent, but the installer explained the product features and even recommended using rinse aid to prevent water stains, so I followed their advice and I think it was a good choice. It is also relatively quiet, and I was pleased that it definitely produces cleaner and neater results than drying by hand. The downside is that I chose this model because it is a recent addition with hot air drying, and the price difference from the previous model was minimal. However, the hot air drying time takes longer than expected, and it seems I have to run it on high for a long time to achieve complete drying, so it doesn't seem to be a very useful feature. The buttons are pretty and neat, turning on with a simple press of the power button, but they are small, so it might be difficult for elderly users to see them. The water inlet hole on the countertop seems almost essential, so I think the website needs to provide a more detailed description. Before purchasing, buyers must verify the product size, whether a water inlet hole is necessary, the location of the inlet and drainage holes, the location of power outlets, and the direction in which the unit opens. In my case, it matched my expectations perfectly, and the installation took only about 20 minutes. Also, I learned during installation that if you install it to open to the left side, the dish rack (see photo) stands upright when you open it, which can be inconvenient, so please keep that in mind. Do you want to avoid washing dishes at all? NO. Do you want to install it on the countertop and run it frequently for convenience? YES. Do you have many pretty and cherished pots and dishes? NO. Do you want to wash dishes thoroughly? Even though they are precious, only the toughest ones survive? YES. After using it a few times, I realized I still had to rinse them roughly before putting them in, so it wasn't completely convenient. However, seeing the dishes looking neater and cleaner than when washed by hand made me feel so good that I think I made the right decision to install it. I hadn't given it much thought about detergent, but the installer explained the product features and even recommended using rinse aid to prevent water stains, so I followed their advice and I think it was a good choice. Thank you once again to the installer for their kind and detailed explanations and the neat installation. I hope buyers consider their own priorities well before making a purchase. #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation

Comments (English): I purchased this because I was looking for a product that fits on a countertop and is suitable for a two-person household. As for the advantages, since I bought it intending to run it frequently even with small amounts, the 30-minute rapid drying function is a significant plus. It is also relatively quiet, and I was pleased that it definitely produces cleaner and neater results than drying by hand. The downside is that I chose this model because it is a recent addition with hot air drying, and the price difference from the previous model was minimal. However, the hot air drying time takes longer than expected, and it seems I have to run it on high for a long time to achieve complete drying, so it doesn't seem to be a very useful feature. The buttons are pretty and neat, turning on with a simple press of the power button, but they are small, so it might be difficult for elderly users to see them. The water inlet hole on the countertop seems almost essential, so I think the website needs to provide a more detailed description. Before purchasing, buyers must verify the product size, whether a water inlet hole is necessary, the location of the inlet and drainage holes, the location of power outlets, and the direction in which the unit opens. In my case, it matched my expectations perfectly, and the installation took only about 20 minutes. Also, I learned during installation that if you install it to open to the left side, the dish rack (see photo) stands upright when you open it, which can be inconvenient, so please keep that in mind. Do you want to avoid washing dishes at all? NO. Do you want to install it on the countertop and run it frequently for convenience? YES. Do you have many pretty and cherished pots and dishes? NO. Do you want to wash dishes thoroughly? Even though they are precious, only the toughest ones survive? YES. After using it a few times, I realized I still had to rinse them roughly before putting them in, so it wasn't completely convenient. However, seeing the dishes looking neater and cleaner than when washed by hand made me feel so good that I think I made the right decision to install it. I hadn't given it much thought about detergent, but the installer explained the product features and even recommended using rinse aid to prevent water stains, so I followed their advice and I think it was a good choice. Thank you once again to the installer for their kind and detailed explanations and the neat installation. I hope buyers consider their own priorities well before making a purchase. #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation

Sentence (English): I recently ordered and installed a Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher (white glass) at my parents' house.
Comments (English): [ A quick and easy-to-install 6-person dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I recently ordered and installed a Samsung Electronics BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher (white glass) at my parents' house. To cut to the chase, I was completely satisfied with the purchase, installation, and design. I'll list the purchase tips and installation in order. 1. Price: I spent a few days debating the timing of my purchase, but I ended up paying at a lower price than I expected thanks to a credit card discount and Coupang promotion. Timing is crucial for large appliances, so I recommend checking for discounts and credit card benefits. 2. Delivery and Installation: Two Samsung installers came on the day of installation and were friendly and professional. They quickly identified the necessary parts and fixed the drain connector, without any unnecessary delays. My parents were also reassured by the friendly explanations they provided regarding any questions they had during the installation process. 3. Installation: Installation was made easier because the induction cooktop already had a pre-drilled hole behind it. This allowed me to connect the drain hose right away and use it without any additional work. Checking your kitchen layout for a suitable drain hole beforehand will make installation much easier. 4. Design: The clean, modern white glass finish blends well with the kitchen interior. The glossy finish makes it easy to maintain and adds a luxurious feel. Since it seats six, it easily handles a day's worth of dishes (plates, pots, and light items). In fact, they say it's incredibly convenient to be able to wash all the dishes used in the morning all at once in the evening! **Overall** - Great value if you time your purchase well (discounts/cards). - The installers were friendly and quick, so there were no worries about initial setup. - High satisfaction with the white glass design. - Installation time can be reduced if there's a pre-drilled drain.

Sentence (English): #opinionmotivatedpromotion This is my third dishwasher, and even though my last one lasted me 13 years, I immediately chose Bosch, and I wasn't disappointed.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Series 4 dishwasher ] || ---------------- || #opinionmotivatedpromotion This is my third dishwasher, and even though my last one lasted me 13 years, I immediately chose Bosch, and I wasn't disappointed. When choosing a dishwasher, I was guided by the reviews, which were very positive. I wanted the third drawer to be not just for cutlery, but also to accommodate cups and bowls. I also wanted the daily cycle to be short (up to an hour) and to clean even dried-on dishes. The recommended dishwasher has a separate cutlery basket. It uses little water, is very spacious and quiet, and most importantly, it washes and dries perfectly, as you can activate the door-opening function at the end of the cycle (which even dries plastic items). Dishes are sparkling after washing. You can connect the dishwasher to an app and select additional programs. After two weeks of using the dishwasher, I can confidently recommend it and think it will serve me for many years (which is very important to me).

Po 2 tygodniach użytkowania zmywarki mogę ją śmiało polecić i myślę, że będzie mi służyć przez wiele lat (na czym mi bardzo zależy).

It would have run nearly $800 with install and all. They're easy but time consuming to install due to tight spaces and having to take apart areas of the dishwasher. Over hyped and priced. Hopefully it will at least last a long time.

Sentence (English): One of the worst experiences I have ever had buying an appliance.
Comments (English): [ Read before you buy. ] || ---------------- || One of the worst experiences I have ever had buying an appliance. Customer service was responsive and helpful. I purchased a GE Dishwasher. The first one came in damaged and had to wait a week for the next one to be delivered and installed. I took a week for them to come back with the 2nd dishwasher. The installers were trying to remove the old dishwasher and couldn't because they said I needed to remove tiles before they can remove. So they left and I had them cancel the order. All that needed to be done was to move the adjusting legs up. My son-in-law and I had this dishwasher removed in 20 minutes. I contacted customer service and ordered another dishwasher. They did give me a gift certificate for installation, since I already removed the old one. One week later, they delivered and installed the new dishwasher. These installers didn't center or balance the unit. When we opened the dishwasher door, it hit the side of our counter—again contacting customer service and having the installers come back out and fix the issues. They came back 5 days later and fixed the problem. It took over 3 weeks to get this accomplished, and many hours calling and texting customer service.

Sentence (English): I've only had my KitchenAid dishwasher a short time, but I've been very impressed with its performance so far.
Comments (English): [ Quieter than my Bosch ] || ---------------- || I've only had my KitchenAid dishwasher a short time, but I've been very impressed with its performance so far. With my old dishwasher, I would have to put at least one or two dishes back through another cycle - especially with any baked on food. But with the KitchenAid, my dishes have been coming out sparkling clean no matter which cycle I use. The racks are spacious enough that I don't need to remove the silverware basket to fit everything in, but I do like the option of using the third rack for utensils and other items. What is most impressive is how quiet this machine is. It's quieter than the Bosch dishwasher I used to have. I have to put my ear up against the machine to tell if it's running. I like the controls on the front panel, although I did accidentally select some functions when I brushed up against it once, and again when I opened the door to load some dishes. The only complaint I have is that the soap dispenser doesn't match the quality of the rest of the machine. The latch is rather flimsy and I'm not sure how long it will last before breaking. Also, it is hard to read the indicator for the rinse agent. Other than that, I have had no problems.

Sentence (English): I had to remove the cabinet and slightly cut the top, which cost an additional 30,000 won.
Comments (English): I had to remove the cabinet and slightly cut the top, which cost an additional 30,000 won. LG said they subsidized 100,000 won, but I think that just covered the basic installation cost. I was going to make a table top for the removed cabinet, but I decided to put it under the balcony shelf to use as an additional snack storage area. I already had some of the pieces separated, so the installation was quick. They brought a grinder and cut it neatly. The finish was so clean that I think it will look great when it's restored. The technician was friendly and explained everything thoroughly, and he even wrapped toilet paper in the hose to check for leaks. Great job! I haven't used it yet because I didn't have the sense to buy detergent in advance, but I trust LG, so I'm not worried.
Comments (Original): 장을빼고 상단부를 살짝 컷팅해야해서 추가비용 3만원들었어요. LG에서 10만원이 지원됐다는데 그냥 기본설치비용을 의미하는것 같았어요. 제거한 상부장은 상판을 짜려다가 베란다 선반아래 넣어서 추가 간식 보관함으로 사용하기로했어요. 일부 분리를 해두었어서 설치가 빨랐어요. 그라인더 가져오셔서 재단해서 깔끔하게 해주셨어요. 마감 깨끗하게 잘 잘려서 복구시 깨끗히 될것 같아요. 기사님 친절하시고 꼼꼼하게 설명해주셨고, 혹시나 누수있을까봐 채크를 위해 호수에 휴지를 감아두고가셨어요. 센스만점! 세제를 미리사두는 센스를 발휘하지 못해 아직 사용해보지는 못했으나 믿고쓰는 LG라 걱정없어요.

Sentence (English): 20 year buyer, last time purchase.
Comments (English): 20 year buyer, last time purchase. Hands down the worst purchase experience of my life. Bought a new dishwasher for our tenants on 9/11. Arrived 9/13. Installer couldn't complete due to valve needing replaced. Hired a qualified plumber to install on 9/18. Scheduled Home Depot's professionals to come back asap on 9/20 to install. Didn't show. Tenants left the country for a week. I rescheduled the install for 9/24 and had a neighbor let them in to install. Installers wedged it in with a broken leg, missing electrical panel, and broken pieces inside, and didn't affix the d/w to the cabinetry. Tenants returned on 10/1 and called out the aforementioned. Reschedule installer and says it's defective and needs replaced. Home Depot tells me it's on Samsung. Samsung tells me it's on Home Depot's installers due to being defective on the exterior vs a mechanical issue. I deal with countless reps each of the four days following where they state each of my claims were within 48 hours of a Home Depot employee being there, they schedule the replacement and then cancelled the day before delivery. I finally accept they won't make this right even though it's still not fully installed and ask to bring the Home Depot rep out one more time to affix this to the cabinetry as is. 10/14 - tech comes out and says there's nothing he can do with it. Brought zero material after requesting from 3 ppl to bring brackets and anything to level this dishwasher. He called Home Depot in front of the customer saying it needs replaced. Superior is going off on him for not bringing parts. Call concludes with replacement order placed again and “processed” only to be canceled again with no notification the day before delivery. Do not let this happen to you. If you're planning renovations or own properties spend the extra buck so you're covered or you will eventually get burned. We were 14/14 on appliances leading into this. Never again

Tenants left the country for a week. I rescheduled the install for 9/24 and had a neighbor let them in to install. Installers wedged it in with a broken leg, missing electrical panel, and broken pieces inside, and didn't affix the d/w to the cabinetry. Tenants returned on 10/1 and called out the aforementioned. Reschedule installer and says it's defective and needs replaced. Home Depot tells me it's on Samsung. Samsung tells me it's on Home Depot's installers due to being defective on the exterior vs a mechanical issue. I deal with countless reps each of the four days following where they state each of my claims were within 48 hours of a Home Depot employee being there, they schedule the replacement and then cancelled the day before delivery. I finally accept they won't make this right even though it's still not fully installed and ask to bring the Home Depot rep out one more time to affix this to the cabinetry as is. 10/14 - tech comes out and says there's nothing he can do with it. Brought zero material after requesting from 3 ppl to bring brackets and anything to level this dishwasher. He called Home Depot in front of the customer saying it needs replaced. Superior is going off on him for not bringing parts. Call concludes with replacement order placed again and “processed” only to be canceled again with no notification the day before delivery. Do not let this happen to you. If you're planning renovations or own properties spend the extra buck so you're covered or you will eventually get burned. We were 14/14 on appliances leading into this. Never again

Installer couldn't complete due to valve needing replaced. Hired a qualified plumber to install on 9/18. Scheduled Home Depot's professionals to come back asap on 9/20 to install. Didn't show. Tenants left the country for a week. I rescheduled the install for 9/24 and had a neighbor let them in to install. Installers wedged it in with a broken leg, missing electrical panel, and broken pieces inside, and didn't affix the d/w to the cabinetry. Tenants returned on 10/1 and called out the aforementioned. Reschedule installer and says it's defective and needs replaced. Home Depot tells me it's on Samsung. Samsung tells me it's on Home Depot's installers due to being defective on the exterior vs a mechanical issue. I deal with countless reps each of the four days following where they state each of my claims were within 48 hours of a Home Depot employee being there, they schedule the replacement and then cancelled the day before delivery. I finally accept they won't make this right even though it's still not fully installed and ask to bring the Home Depot rep out one more time to affix this to the cabinetry as is. 10/14 - tech comes out and says there's nothing he can do with it. Brought zero material after requesting from 3 ppl to bring brackets and anything to level this dishwasher. He called Home Depot in front of the customer saying it needs replaced. Superior is going off on him for not bringing parts. Call concludes with replacement order placed again and “processed” only to be canceled again with no notification the day before delivery. Do not let this happen to you. If you're planning renovations or own properties spend the extra buck so you're covered or you will eventually get burned. We were 14/14 on appliances leading into this. Never again

Sentence (English): Love the look and style of this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher rusting at 9 months old. ] || ---------------- || Love the look and style of this dishwasher. Very quiet when its running. Third rack is great as well. Dishes come out very clean. Functions well. Biggest disappointment was that it began to show signs of rust on the top of the dishwasher and the protective coating is peeling off on the bottom of the dishwasher when it was only 9 months old. Bosch has issued a credit to Lowes so we can purchase another product.

It's somewhat quiet, but not super quiet by any measure. Overall, a very good dishwasher so far, can't quite put it in the 'great' category.

Sentence (English): I was using an LG product and bought this one because of its cost-effectiveness.
Comments (English): I was using an LG product and bought this one because of its cost-effectiveness. Comparing the two, this one has two blades, while the LG has four. The cleaning performance felt like I'd misplaced the dishes, leaving a bit of oil behind (which made me have to be careful when loading them). The LG seems to have better cleaning power, even cleaning the dirty dishes in the air fryer. However, the basic cleaning time is 59 minutes for this model, while the LG's is 1 hour and 50 minutes. There may be a time difference. The LG also dries, but this model has a separate drying setting. The LG has separate upper and lower compartments for washing. This model doesn't have that feature. It only has basic and dirty dishes. The LG didn't have a door-opening function (it's an older model), but this one does, which is nice. Also, since I don't have to set a separate drying time, I can wash the dishes in an hour, which saves energy. I purchased it for a low price of 290,000 won, including the WowWow promotion. With free repair insurance, I paid a little over 300,000 won, so I'm satisfied with the price.

Sentence (English): I was using an LG product and bought this one because of its cost-effectiveness.
Comments (English): I was using an LG product and bought this one because of its cost-effectiveness. Let's compare the two. First, this one has two blades, while the LG has four. The cleaning performance felt like I'd misplaced the dishes, leaving a bit of oil behind (which made me have to be careful when loading them). The LG seems to have better cleaning power, even cleaning the dirty dishes from the air fryer. However, the basic cleaning time for this product is 59 minutes, while the LG's is 1 hour and 50 minutes. There may be a time difference. The LG also dries, but this product has a separate drying setting. The LG has separate upper and lower compartments for washing. This product doesn't have that feature. It only has basic and dirty dishes. The LG didn't have a door-opening function (it's an older model), but this one does, which is nice. Also, since I don't have to set a separate drying time, I can wash the dishes in an hour, which saves energy. I purchased it for a low price of 290,000 won, including the WowWow promotion. With free repair insurance, I paid a little over 300,000 won, so I'm satisfied with the price.

Sentence (English): I used a competitor's product for nearly 10 years, but I recently switched to a Samsung 6-place setting.
Comments (English): I used a competitor's product for nearly 10 years, but I recently switched to a Samsung 6-place setting. Sentence (English): I received the dishwasher on October 9, but unfortunately, the unit was defective right out of the box.
Comments (English): [ Disappointing Experience Support ] || ---------------- || I received the dishwasher on October 9, but unfortunately, the unit was defective right out of the box. When I tried to run it (about 72 hours after delivery), it immediately displayed error code 7 – pause – 2 – pause – “Clean” light blinking, which according to the manual indicates a wash motor failure. I contacted customer service, and the earliest available service appointment was October 24. Even more frustrating, the store's return policy only allows returns within 48 hours. Because I didn't try to use the dishwasher until day three, I was stuck with a broken unit I couldn't return. This has been a deeply frustrating experience. The product may work well when functioning properly, but the lack of flexibility in return policies and slow response time for service on a brand-new item is unacceptable. I regret this purchase and would not recommend it unless you're willing to risk this kind of hassle if something goes wrong.

Sentence (English): I was looking for a dishwasher, a must-have for newlyweds, and after analyzing every model, I finally chose the DUE6BGL3E!
Comments (English): I was looking for a dishwasher, a must-have for newlyweds, and after analyzing every model, I finally chose the DUE6BGL3E! After using it, I'm honestly wondering why I waited so long to buy it. Thanks to the TrueSteam and hot water wash, soup stains and grease are virtually gone, and my cups look sparkling. And thanks to the auto-opening feature, which automatically opens the door after each wash to evaporate any moisture inside, and the hot air/condensation drying function, I'm completely satisfied with the drying performance. Dishes come out fluffy and soft. Even at night, it's so quiet you might wonder if it's even running. The interior is spacious, so it's easy to store pots and large pans, and the three-tier basket design allows you to fold and adjust the height, making it a great space-saving option. While the DUE6BGL is the latest model, it's about 500,000 won more expensive, which I initially thought was lacking in value. However, with the growing popularity of this model, I initially chose the DUE6BGL1E~3E models, which offer three-tiers and a better value. Among them, I ended up choosing the DUE6BGL3E model because it had the best price and side rack. To save others time, the DUE6BGL3E model has a side rack, but it is a full-touch screen and does not have voice function. The DUE6BGL2E model has a top-mounted touchscreen and voice guidance function, but does not have a side rack. Sentence (English): The dishwasher runs quietly, exactly as the manufacturer promises.
Comments (English): [ A great choice for your first kitchen ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher runs quietly, exactly as the manufacturer promises. The cutlery drawer is very convenient, and the baskets hold a lot of dishes. The height-adjustable top basket is a nice feature, allowing you to easily load taller glasses or stemware. Dishes, pots, and cutlery are super clean after removal. This is great news for me, because sometimes some dishwashers don't clean several days' worth of dirt, but this one does a great job. A big plus. I also like that after the wash cycle is finished, the door opens automatically, leaving the dishes dry and ready to put away. I treated the phone connection as a gimmick, but I quickly learned how convenient it is, and you can immediately see when the cycle is over. #opiniamotivowanapromocą
Comments (Original): [ Świetny wybór do pierwszej kuchni ] || ---------------- || Zmywarka chodzi cicho, dokładnie tak jak obiecuje producent. Bardzo wygodna jest szuflada na sztućce, a kosze mieszczą naprawdę sporo naczyń. Fajna opcja z regulacją wysokości górnego kosza i można spokojnie włożyć wyższe szklanki czy kieliszki.Naczynia, garnki, oraz sztućce mega czyste po wyjęciu. Dla mnie to super informacja, bo czasami niektóre zmywarki nie domywają zabrudzeń z kilku dni, a ta sobie świetnie radzi. Duży plus.Podoba mi się też, że po zakończeniu zmywania drzwi same się uchylają a naczynia są suche i gotowe do schowania. Połączenie z telefonem traktowałam jako gadżet, ale szybko się przekonałam, że to wygodne i widać od razu, kiedy cykl się kończy.#opiniamotywowanapromocją

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is a good value in today's market.

The door is extremely light and I was worried this may indicated poor build quality. Thankfully, I have found that not to be the case. The dishes are spotless and the very low decibel level is shared by few others at this price. The fingerprint resistant finish is not perfect, but only lacks in the polished areas of the handle. I am very satisfied with this appliance.

Sentence (English): LG is love!
Comments (English): [ I should have done it earlier. But the cost of the sub-floor construction was a tearjerker. ] || ---------------- || LG is love! This is a genuine review of the S2 dishwasher, which I bought with my own money. I've been eyeing the 12-person dishwasher for a while, but I had a hard time deciding. In our apartment, installing a dishwasher required cabinet work. The cost of the work was prohibitive, so I kept putting it off. But as dishwashing became increasingly difficult, I finally took the plunge and bought one. ^_ I should've bought it sooner. There are three of us in my household, and I cook a lot, so the dishes pile up every day. Especially with greasy pots and pans, and even the baby's dishes, I had to wash them separately, so I had to do it three times a day. The process of running the water, standing, washing, rinsing, and drying the dishes was tedious and tiring, but now I can save time. When I first used it, I was skeptical about how well it would clean, but I was surprised at how well it worked. Even greasy plates and frying pans were cleaned cleanly after a quick wipe. The baby's dishes were also cleaned thoroughly, giving me peace of mind about hygiene. When I opened the door after the wash, I could see a wisp of warm steam rising, indicating that the dishwasher had dried well. Being able to remove the dry dishes and put them away right away was also satisfying. Best of all, it wasn't as noisy as I'd expected, so I didn't mind running it while the baby was sleeping. Just throwing in the dishes at night and pressing a button made my day feel much more relaxed. The design, to be honest, wasn't particularly pretty or sophisticated. It's not tacky or out of place either; it's more of a neutral feel. It's a design that would fit in well with any kitchen (though it does have a slightly older, built-in feel). The functionality was so good that I quickly forgot about the design. The installation required cabinet work, which added quite a bit of extra cost. It's worth considering this in advance. Besides the actual cost of the dishwasher itself, installation and interior modifications can be a significant burden. But after installing it, I realized it was a really good choice because it saved me so much time washing dishes. I'm especially concerned about sterilizing and maintaining hygiene because I have a lot of baby dishes, but using this product has made that much easier. Washing with hot water removes grease and sterilizes dishes, which gives me peace of mind. It's really saved me a lot of time. I'm starting to realize how much a small change like this can make a big difference when raising a child. At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but now I'm so happy I didn't get one sooner. I highly recommend it to anyone who cooks frequently or has a lot of dishes. Most importantly, saving time on dishes has made my days so much more relaxed and my mood has improved. While the exterior may be plain, the functionality and performance are truly satisfying. Sentence (English): Less than a year after installation (which was a nightmare in itself, though I'll stay focused on the product), rust began forming on the outside of the dishwasher door, and the finish started peeling off the bottom.
Comments (English): [ Regret This Purchase ] || ---------------- || Less than a year after installation (which was a nightmare in itself, though I'll stay focused on the product), rust began forming on the outside of the dishwasher door, and the finish started peeling off the bottom. I've been extremely gentle with it, no abrasive cleaners, just wiping with Kirkland yellow microfiber cloths and water. When I contacted Costco's warranty services, they sent a local technician who came prepared with a canned response: Whirlpool's warranty (which Costco doubles to two years) doesn't cover rust or finish issues unless they appear within the first three months. "Repairman" didn't do anything but run a cycle, repeat the policy that won't cover the finish and left. To be clear: I don't cook. We eat out most of the time. This dishwasher has been used less than once a week for under a year, and it's already rusting below the vent. That's unacceptable for a major appliance from a brand like Maytag. If you're considering this model, I strongly recommend looking elsewhere. Between the premature wear and the lack of meaningful warranty support, this has been a frustrating and disappointing experience.

Sentence (English): You absolutely MUST buy a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It's so convenient and great! And the colors are pretty too! ] || ---------------- || You absolutely MUST buy a dishwasher. Hello! This is Jelly Bear, your smart shopping enthusiast. Today, I’m going to review the LG Objet Collection built-in dishwasher! We are a family of four, and we use so many dishes that there are never any left in the kitchen after just one meal. After doing the cleanup, I get so exhausted that I don't want to do anything else. I'm sure other housewives will understand, right? Before buying the dishwasher, I thought it was an unnecessary product because since we just rinse the dishes once before putting them in, there wasn't much difference from washing them by hand. In the beginning, aligning the dishes into their designated spots was stressful, and it took nearly three hours. So, even after installing the dishwasher, I continued washing by hand. However, I decided to give it a try and got into the habit despite the hassle. Now that the dish spots are set and I use the mode that suits my home, it takes about an hour—enough. Of course, since I only need to pre-wash, it takes only one-third the time compared to washing by hand. I even tried putting in some greasy dishes on purpose, and they came out squeaky clean! If you are hesitating about buying a dishwasher, just buy it! You will definitely find it convenient once you get used to it. Make sure to buy a dishwasher!

I am realizing just how much of a help such a small change is while raising a child. I highly recommend it to households that cook frequently or have a lot of dishes to wash. Sentence (English): Bought just about a month ago, and unfortunately the heating element melted a hole into the lower spray arm, which deformed the plastic and caused a hole that sprayed water down into the bottom edge and corners of the basin, which leaked substantially out the door.
Comments (English): [ Leaked after melting spray arm ] || ---------------- || Bought just about a month ago, and unfortunately the heating element melted a hole into the lower spray arm, which deformed the plastic and caused a hole that sprayed water down into the bottom edge and corners of the basin, which leaked substantially out the door. About a quart leaked every wash. This dishwasher is NOT leak-proof against any water that is not spraying up and falling down. And the spray arms, which are 1/2" from the heating element, are made of plastic! Costco was very helpful to get us a service appointment through GE's contractor, but the contractor cancelled the appointment day-of AFTER confirming it with me over the phone, and they couldn't reschedule with us. Costco helpfully offered to find another contractor, but when I told them a part had melted, they warned me it would be considered *cosmetic* and not covered under warranty. I told them that's stupid, plus it still shouldn't be leaking. So they offered to replace it for free, since it was within 90 days. This is now what we're doing.Hopefully it was just a fluke, but I dunno. Those spray arms are made of plastic and they're pretty wobbly. Will have to see if it happens again; if it does, I'm not getting another GE dishwasher. (Or a Whirlpool, which this one replaced due to an issue with the heating element as well! )Happy with Costco customer service at least.

Sentence (English): We bought this Maytag dishwasher to upgrade our old one that came with the house.
Comments (English): [ Needs permanent repair ] || ---------------- || We bought this Maytag dishwasher to upgrade our old one that came with the house. We never had problems with the older one except if felt that the pump was becoming less powerful and dishes are not cleaned as well. So we were excited to get this Maytag - and it became a nightmare. Out of the box there was trouble. Drain errors E1F9, again and again, most of the time. countless repeats trying to get the dishes cleaned, trouble shooting, perhaps I did not put the drain line right ? is it kinked? too high? to long? Dishwasher built out, in, out, in, again and again. Spend way too much time on this crap before calling it quits. Taking it out again, technician comes and 'knows'. Those dishwashers seem to have a design flaw. Impossible for me to tell how many new ones need the fix, but it seems to be common. A week or so later we got the pump assembly replaced (3 x more dishwasher installed in, out, in). It worked! For 4 months, then the dreaded error again. 1 out of 5, then 5 out of 5 times. Dirty dishes all over everywhere now.Calling again, needs replacement again. Again? Build it in, next week out again so the technician can replace the same assembly again. Quick internet search: these dishwashers have a design flaw: food that fits through the large inlet mesh gets stuck in the motor and kills it. happens again and again. So one design error that just causes the error for no reason, and then the one that allows food to kill the motor. If this is even the issue, who knows.We had this for 9 months. 3 months out of these we could not do dishes. We have children, we are busy working all day. This dishwasher was source of a lot of grief. Customer service: not a lot of help. Yes, they do offer warranty during warranty period and they ARE good with that. But if you are stuck with a dishwasher that KEEPS breaking, you are left holding the bag.My options? Keep buying warranty. For a 10 year lifespan, add these 750$ (! ) do your purchase price! And this is only if you are willing and have the time and nerves to keep getting this thing repaired and can live with dirty dishes weeks at a time. Customer service was unwilling to provide ANY other relief than offering repeated repair UNTIL the warranty is out. No warranty extension. No take back. I am going to throw it out as this will be a source of more costs and headache. Never Maytag again - ever.

Sentence (English): ⭐ Extremely Disappointed — Unprofessional Service, Poor Workmanship, and Zero AccountabilityI am writing this review after months of frustration and disappointment with this company's service and customer care.
Comments (English): [ ⭐ Extremely Disappointed — Unprofessional Service, Poor Workmanship, and Zero Accountability ] || ---------------- || ⭐ Extremely Disappointed — Unprofessional Service, Poor Workmanship, and Zero AccountabilityI am writing this review after months of frustration and disappointment with this company's service and customer care.About five months ago, I contacted this company to repair my dishwasher, which had an issue with the door. A technician came, supposedly fixed the problem, and I paid around $400–$500 for the repair on the same day.However, less than four weeks later, the exact same problem reappeared. I immediately called the company to report that the repair had failed and scheduled another appointment. When the technician called me on the day of the appointment, he told me he did not have the part, even though I had clearly explained when scheduling that it was the same issue and same part.What's worse, the technician mentioned that he knew the previous repairman and that the first repair had been done incorrectly — only one side of the mechanism was fixed instead of both, which is why it broke again. He told me they would call me back to reschedule once they had the part.No one called.After two weeks of waiting, I called again — they still didn't have the part. I called again later — now they claimed to have it, so another appointment was scheduled. On the day of that appointment, the technician called me to say that the part had been given to someone else, so he couldn't come.Since then, it has been months of endless phone calls — I've been calling two to three times every week — and every time, I hear a different excuse:“We need to email the supervisor.”“We'll call you back.”“The part isn't available.”“The technician will contact you soon.”No one ever calls back. No one takes responsibility. And nothing ever gets fixed.At this point, it has been five months since the initial repair, which failed almost immediately, and I am still left with a broken dishwasher. I have paid hundreds of dollars for a repair that was never properly completed, and despite repeatedly asking for a refund, no one from the company has responded or followed up.This level of negligence, lack of professionalism, and total disregard for the customer is unacceptable. The workmanship was poor, the technicians were unprepared, and the customer service has been nothing short of atrocious.Frankly, it feels as though the company took my money and walked away, leaving me with the same broken appliance and no accountability whatsoever. For a company that claims to be reputable and reliable, this experience has been the complete opposite — disorganized, careless, and disrespectful to the customer.I expect immediate resolution — either a proper repair at no additional cost or a full refund for the failed service. Anything less would confirm that this company simply does not stand behind its work.

I live in a 24-pyeong (approximately 800 square meters) apartment with a 14-month-old baby. Since dishwashers from brands S and C are manufactured by My Deer through ODM and OEM, I figured there wouldn't be much difference in performance, so I bought a My Deer product! I maintain the dishwasher by cleaning the filter once every 1-2 weeks and using the dishwasher cleaner tablet once every two weeks on a standard cycle. (가격 대비 기능 비율 고려 시)  ⚠️ 단점 / 유의사항 ￼ •일부 선반 높이 조절이 제한적일 수 있음 •설치 방식 (빌트인 vs 프리스탠딩)과 급수/배수 배관 조건을 반드시 확인해야 함 •건조 성능은 제품마다 차이 있을 수 있으나, 자동문 열림 + 송풍 건조 + 내부 구조(환기 설계 등) 조건을 봐야 함 •가격 변동 확인요망 — 특가/할인 등으로 변동 확인 ‼️구매 팁 & 체크리스트  1.설치 공간 크기 확인 - 앞뒤, 좌우 여유 공간도 고려 - 문 여는 방향 / 여유 확보 필요 2.배관 조건 확인 - 수도 급·배수 위치 - 배관 길이 & 높이 차이 3.내부 구성 / 선반 유연성 - 높이 조절 가능 여부 - 컵/찻잔 거치대 유무 4.건조 성능 / 내부 습도 제어 기능 - 자동문 열림 기능 - 팬 또는 송풍 건조 여부 - 내부 통풍 구조 5.편의 기능 확인 - 잔여시간 표시 - 조작 방식 (터치, 버튼 등) 6.서비스망 / A/S 조건 - 마이디어 / 미디어 제품의 A/S 가능 지역 - 부품 교체 가능성  전반적으로 만족스러운 제품입니다.  삼성 식기세척기를 썼었는데, 그 제품에 비해서도 가성비로 뒤쳐지지 않는 것 같아요. 단 식세기 세제는 꼭 좋은걸 쓰시길 추천드립니다^^  사진은 추가로 올리겠습니다.

Comments (English): [ Very pleased ] || ---------------- || I've had my Bosch DW about a month and I'm very satisfied. I liked my previous Bosch so that's why I chose another Bosch again. Still getting used to this. It only comes with 1 silverware basket which I haven't used yet and 1 isn't sufficient for all of my silverware. Sentence (English): Before we got married, my husband promised me he'd buy me a dishwasher someday!
Comments (English): [ Auntie, please bring the dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || Before we got married, my husband promised me he'd buy me a dishwasher someday! And after years, he finally kept his promise. It was a long wait, but now that I finally got my dishwasher, I realize why everyone loves it. Coupang delivery is truly fast. The installer contacted me the day before to confirm the cabinet size and kindly explained any potential additional costs. My home has non-standard cabinets and low cabinet heights, making installation difficult. The installer was incredibly thorough and worked out the best solution possible at the lowest possible cost. Thanks to him, the installation was much cleaner than I expected. If you're planning on getting a rebate after installation, be sure to check the location of the energy label and nameplate! The label is on the front, and the nameplate is located at the top of the dishwasher door when you open it. (The engineer explained everything in detail, so I took a picture of it right away.) It's incredibly intuitive. Even without reading the manual, you can get the hang of it after pressing a button or two. The "normal" cycle is rated for five hours, but the actual wash time is about an hour, with the rest being drying time. So, I can leave it on overnight and get out the door completely dry the next morning, which is incredibly convenient. The "1-Hour Express Course" has good cleaning power, but it leaves a little moisture behind, so I use it when I'm in a hurry before guests arrive or when I don't have a lot of dishes. The installer even tested the water for limescale with a test kit, and since the color didn't change at all, he said I didn't need to add salt. This meticulous attention to detail gave me confidence. And one more detail! The energy rating label sticker is attached to the protective film, so it peels off easily. After removing the sticker, the exterior looks much cleaner and more luxurious, which really boosted my satisfaction. I did my first wash that evening, and I was surprised at how much squeakier and shinier the dishes were than when I washed them by hand. The glasses were crystal clear, and the pots and pans sparkled! The saying, "Once you've used a dishwasher, you can't go back," really rings true. Summary of Pros: The installer was friendly and thorough (even a non-standard cabinet was installed without any problems!) (The sink cabinet was 810mm, but I solved it by raising the countertop a bit. Even if you think the sink cabinet height doesn't match, you can order it first and discuss it with the installer. If it's not completely impossible, they'll come up with a solution.) Intuitive to use, almost no instructions needed. Excellent cleaning power, even glasses are clean. The regular cycle is best for running at night (you can take it out completely dry in the morning). The label sticker is easily removable, and the exterior is clean. Careful installation service that even includes a limescale test. Cons: The rapid cycle leaves a little moisture behind. Additional costs may apply depending on the installation environment. In summary, this is the appliance that captured my heart after the washer/dryer. More than anything, I didn't know that the sense of freedom of not having to do dishes would be this great. I can now take care of the kids and have a quick cup of coffee. Now I don't want to go back to the days when we didn't have a dishwasher, even for a day. Husband, thank you for keeping your promise! You did a great job this time. + My 20-month-old baby has been touching it nonstop since installation. The button lock is essential. You can even start washing by pressing the reservation button for just 3 seconds! Even if a baby presses it like a toy, the dishwasher does its job.

The technician was very kind and thorough in explaining everything and was on time when he visited. He even called me in advance if he was running late. Because of work, I couldn't easily schedule an appointment, but the technician was very considerate. This is a review after installation. Pros & Cons: Pros: The automatic door opening function helps drain moisture and improve drying after washing (reducing humidity). Convenient features include a remaining time display, front touch operation, and a mid-loading feature. The appropriate capacity and size make it a good size for home use. Many reviews rave about the value for money! (Considering the price-to-performance ratio) Disadvantages / Notes Some shelf height adjustments may be limited. Be sure to check the installation method (built-in vs. freestanding) and water supply/drainage piping conditions. Drying performance may vary depending on the product, but automatic door opening + ventilation drying + internal structure (ventilation design, etc.) conditions must be considered. Price fluctuations must be checked. Changes due to special offers/discounts, etc. Purchase tips & checklist 1. Check the installation space size - Consider the front/rear, left/right clearance as well - Door opening direction / clearance required 2. Check the piping conditions - Water supply/drainage location - Difference in piping length & height 3. Internal configuration / shelf flexibility - Height adjustment possible - Presence of cup/teacup holder 4. Drying performance / internal humidity control function - Automatic door opening function - Fan or ventilation drying - Internal ventilation structure 5. Check the convenience features - Remaining time display - Operation method (touch, button, etc.) 6. Service network / A/S conditions - Media / A/S available areas for media products - Possibility of parts replacement Overall, it is a satisfactory product. I used to use a Samsung dishwasher, and I think this one is just as good value for money as that one. However, I highly recommend using a good dishwashing detergent. I'll add more photos.

Check the installation space size - Consider the front/rear, left/right clearance as well - Door opening direction / clearance required 2. Check the piping conditions - Water supply/drainage location - Difference in piping length & height 3. Internal configuration / shelf flexibility - Height adjustment possible - Presence of cup/teacup holder 4. (가격 대비 기능 비율 고려 시)⚠️ 단점 / 유의사항  ￼•일부 선반 높이 조절이 제한적일 수 있음•설치 방식 (빌트인 vs 프리스탠딩)과 급수/배수 배관 조건을 반드시 확인해야 함•건조 성능은 제품마다 차이 있을 수 있으나, 자동문 열림 + 송풍 건조 + 내부 구조(환기 설계 등) 조건을 봐야 함•가격 변동 확인요망 — 특가/할인 등으로 변동 확인 ‼️구매 팁 & 체크리스트1.설치 공간 크기 확인- 앞뒤, 좌우 여유 공간도 고려- 문 여는 방향 / 여유 확보 필요2.배관 조건 확인- 수도 급·배수 위치- 배관 길이 & 높이 차이3.내부 구성 / 선반 유연성- 높이 조절 가능 여부- 컵/찻잔 거치대 유무4.건조 성능 / 내부 습도 제어 기능- 자동문 열림 기능- 팬 또는 송풍 건조 여부- 내부 통풍 구조5.편의 기능 확인- 잔여시간 표시- 조작 방식 (터치, 버튼 등)6.서비스망 / A/S 조건- 마이디어 / 미디어 제품의 A/S 가능 지역- 부품 교체 가능성전반적으로 만족스러운 제품입니다. 삼성 식기세척기를 썼었는데, 그 제품에 비해서도 가성비로 뒤쳐지지 않는 것 같아요. 단 식세기 세제는 꼭 좋은걸 쓰시길 추천드립니다^^ 사진은 추가로 올리겠습니다.

Sentence (English): This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money.
Comments (English): [ Best value dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I live in a 24-pyeong (approximately 86 square meters) apartment with a 14-month-old baby. Since we started feeding him baby food, the dishes have been overwhelming, so I've been looking for a dishwasher. Since we're renting, a built-in one isn't an option. So, I looked for a freestanding dishwasher, but they were all too expensive. Since dishwashers from companies S and C are manufactured by My Deer ODM and OEM, I figured there wouldn't be much difference in performance, so I bought a My Deer product! I use it to run everything from pots and pans to silicone baby dishes, BPA-free cups, airtight containers, and more. I wash non-stick pans, scissors, and knives by hand. I cook one meal a day, and my baby eats three, so there's a lot of dishwashing to do, so I run it at least once a day! I usually add drying to the standard setting, and occasionally, if there are a lot of dirty dishes, I run it on high heat. The downside is that it doesn't dry well, but I leave the door wide open before going to bed after running it, and when I wake up in the morning, they're all dry! Since I also use baby dishes, I don't use a separate rinse aid. Instead, I use a single-use all-in-one tablet detergent that includes rinse aid. I rinse the dishes with water once when they're dirty and then put them back in, and they're clean with just one detergent! I maintain the dishwasher by cleaning the filter once every 1-2 weeks and using a tablet-type dishwasher cleaner once every two weeks on a standard cycle. Because there's always moisture inside, hygiene is crucial. If you're thinking about buying this product but haven't made a purchase because all the reviews are from trial groups, I highly recommend it! L's products have more features and better technology, but many other brands of dishwashers are made by Mydia. I'm not sure about the after-sales service, but I've been using it for about 3 weeks now and I'm very satisfied with the cleaning process! Using a dishwasher has truly improved my quality of life! I hope anyone considering it can get a Dishwasher Auntie as soon as possible.
Comments (Original): [ 가격대비 성능 최고 식기세척기! ] || ---------------- || 내돈내산 후기입니다.구축 24평 아파트에 살고있는 3인 가구입니다.14개월 아기를 키우고 있는데 유아식 시작하고부터 설거지가 너무 많이 나와서 식세기를 구매하려고 찾아보는데 집에 전세라서 빌트인은 불가능하기 때문에 프리스탠딩으로 찾아보니 가격이 다 너무 쎄더라구요ㅠㅠ S사, C사 식세기는 마이디어 ODM, OEM으로 생산되는 제품이기 때문에 성능은 크게 차이 없을 것 같아서 마이디어 제품으로 구매했습니다~!!냄비부터 실리콘 소재의 아기 식기, BPA FREE 소재의 컵, 밀폐용기 등등 다 넣고 돌리고 코팅팬이나 가위, 칼은 손설거지로 하고 있어요. 하루 한끼는 요리를 해서 먹고 아기는 하루 세끼 밥을 먹으니 설거지가 꽤 많이 나와서 하루 한번 이상은 꼭 돌리고 있어요!저는 보통 표준에 건조 추가, 가끔 오염된 그릇이 많으면 고온세척으로 돌려요. 건조가 잘 안된다는 단점이 있는데 작동 후 자기 전이 문 활짝 열어놓고 자고 일어나서 아침에 보면 어느정도 말라있어요! 아기 식기도 같이 돌리기 때문에 린스는 따로 안쓰고 린스 포함되어있는 1종 올인원 태블릿 세제 사용하고 있습니다.물로 그릇 오염 한번씩 헹구고 넣으면 1종 세제로도 깨끗히 닦여요!식세기 관리는 1-2주에 한번 필터 청소, 2주에 한번 태블릿 형식의 식세기 클리너 넣고 표준코스 돌려서 관리하고 있어요.내부에 항상 습기가 있기 때문에 위생 관리가 정말 중요하더라구요.이 제품 구매하고 싶은데 다 체험단 리뷰라서 구매까지 이어지지 않으시는 분들이라면 저는 구매 추천드립니다!L사 제품은 기능도 많고 기술력이 더 좋겠지만 다른 브랜드 식기세척기는 마이디어에서 생산하는 제품이 많더라구요.AS는 어떨지 모르겠지만.. 지금 3주정도 사용해보니 세척도 잘 되고 넘 만족스러워요! 식세기 사용해보니 삶의질이 정말 달라지더라구요!! 고민하시는 분들 하루라도 빨리 식세기 이모님 들이시길 바랍니다☺️

I wanted a built-in option, but after the technician visited, due to space constraints, I ended up installing a freestanding option. He was very friendly and explained everything thoroughly and was punctual when he arrived. He even called me in advance if he was running late. Because of work, I couldn't schedule a convenient appointment, but the technician was very accommodating. This is my review after installation. Pros & Considerations. Pros. The automatic door opening function helps drain moisture and improve drying efficiency after washing (reducing humidity). User-friendly features include a remaining time display, front touch operation, and a mid-loading feature. The appropriate combination of capacity and size makes it a good size for home use. Many reviews laud its value for money! (Considering the price-to-performance ratio). Cons / Notes. Some shelf height adjustments may be limited. Be sure to check the installation method (built-in vs. freestanding) and water supply/drainage plumbing conditions. Drying performance may vary by product, but factors such as automatic door opening, air drying, and internal structure (ventilation design, etc.) should be considered. Price fluctuations are subject to change due to special offers and discounts. Purchase tips & checklist: 1. Check the installation space. - Consider front, back, left, and right clearance. - Door opening direction / Ensure sufficient clearance. 2. Check the plumbing conditions. - Water supply and drainage locations. - Plumbing length & height differences. 3. Internal configuration / shelf flexibility. - Height adjustment. - Cup/tea cup holder. 4. Drying performance / internal humidity control. - Automatic door opening. - Fan or air drying. - Internal ventilation. 5. Check the convenience features. - Remaining time display. - Operation method (touch, button, etc.). 6. Service network / A/S conditions. - Media / A/S coverage areas for media products. - Possibility of replacing parts. Overall, I'm satisfied with this product. I used a Samsung dishwasher, and this one is comparable in cost-effectiveness to that model. However, I highly recommend using a good dishwashing detergent. I will upload additional photos.

Sentence (English): Before we got married, my husband promised to buy me a dishwasher someday, and after several years, he finally kept that promise.
Comments (English): [ Make sure to get a dishwasher lady! ] || ---------------- || Before we got married, my husband promised to buy me a dishwasher someday, and after several years, he finally kept that promise. The wait was long, but now that I have it, I understand why everyone raves about dishwashers. As expected, Coupang delivery is the epitome of speed. The technician contacted me the day before installation to check the cabinet dimensions in advance and kindly explained any potential additional costs. Installation wasn't easy because our cabinets are non-standard and the base cabinets are low, but the technician was incredibly thorough and managed to resolve the issue as affordably as possible. Thanks to him, the installation turned out much neater than expected. If you plan to claim a refund after installation, make sure to check the locations of the energy label and nameplate! The label is on the front, and the nameplate is attached to the top when you open the dishwasher door. (The technician explained it in detail, so I took a picture of it right away.) The usage is incredibly intuitive. You don't even need to look at the manual; you'll get the hang of it quickly after pressing a button once or twice. The 'Standard Course' displays a total of 5 hours, but the actual washing takes about an hour, with the rest being drying time. So, it is so convenient for me to run it overnight and take the dishes out completely dry in the morning. The '1-Hour Quick Cycle' offers good cleaning power but leaves a little water behind, so I use it when I need to use it urgently before guests arrive or when there aren't many dishes. The installation technician even tested the water for limescale using a test kit; since the color didn't change at all, he said I didn't need to add salt. I felt confident because he took such meticulous care of even this detail. And here's another detail point! The energy rating label sticker is attached over the protective film, so it peels off very easily. After removing the sticker, the exterior looked much cleaner and more luxurious, which boosted my satisfaction. I ran the first wash right away in the evening, and I was surprised by how much cleaner and shinier the dishes were than when I washed them by hand. The glass cups were clear, and the pots and pans were sparkling! The saying "once you've used a dishwasher, you can't go back" really fits the situation. Summary of pros: The installation technician was kind and meticulous (handling non-standard cabinets without any issues!). (My kitchen cabinet was 810mm, but I solved the problem by lifting the countertop a bit. Even if you think the cabinet height might not fit, just place the order first; if you discuss it with the technician, they will find a solution unless it is completely impossible.) Intuitive to use, manual is practically unnecessary. Excellent cleaning power; even glass cups come out squeaky clean. The standard cycle is optimal for running at night (you can take it out completely dry in the morning). Label stickers are easy to remove, and the exterior is neat. Meticulous installation service that even includes a limescale test. One drawback: The quick cycle leaves a little water behind. Additional costs may apply depending on the installation environment. To sum it up, this is the appliance that captured my heart the most after the washer-dryer. Above all, I didn't realize how great the sense of liberation from not having to do the dishes would be. I now have the time to look after the kids and even have a moment to enjoy a cup of coffee. Now, I don't want to go back to the days without a dishwasher for even a single day. I am writing this review after months of frustration and disappointment with this company's service and customer care. About five months ago, I contacted this company to repair my dishwasher, which had an issue with the door. A technician came, supposedly fixed the problem, and I paid around $400–$500 for the repair on the same day. However, less than four weeks later, the exact same problem reappeared. I immediately called the company to report that the repair had failed and scheduled another appointment. When the technician called me on the day of the appointment, he told me he did not have the part, even though I had clearly explained when scheduling that it was the same issue and same part. What's worse, the technician mentioned that he knew the previous repairman and that the first repair had been done incorrectly — only one side of the mechanism was fixed instead of both, which is why it broke again. He told me they would call me back to reschedule once they had the part. No one called. After two weeks of waiting, I called again — they still didn't have the part. I called again later — now they claimed to have it, so another appointment was scheduled. On the day of that appointment, the technician called me to say that the part had been given to someone else, so he couldn't come. Since then, it has been months of endless phone calls — I've been calling two to three times every week — and every time, I hear a different excuse:. “We need to email the supervisor.”. “We'll call you back.”. “The part isn't available.”. “The technician will contact you soon.”. No one ever calls back. No one takes responsibility. And nothing ever gets fixed. At this point, it has been five months since the initial repair, which failed almost immediately, and I am still left with a broken dishwasher. I have paid hundreds of dollars for a repair that was never properly completed, and despite repeatedly asking for a refund, no one from the company has responded or followed up. This level of negligence, lack of professionalism, and total disregard for the customer is unacceptable. The workmanship was poor, the technicians were unprepared, and the customer service has been nothing short of atrocious. Frankly, it feels as though the company took my money and walked away, leaving me with the same broken appliance and no accountability whatsoever. For a company that claims to be reputable and reliable, this experience has been the complete opposite — disorganized, careless, and disrespectful to the customer. I expect immediate resolution — either a proper repair at no additional cost or a full refund for the failed service. Anything less would confirm that this company simply does not stand behind its work.

Sentence (English): This is a very nice and quiet dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great unit that may have a limited lifespan ] || ---------------- || This is a very nice and quiet dishwasher. The display on the outside of the unit that tells you the time remaining is very useful. It cleans dishes well. The adjustable height of the top rack is very useful. I'm still getting used to loading it; it has a very different layout than my old KitchenAid. It dries very nicely, too. The app can give helpful, descriptive error messages, like if the lower arm is being blocked by something. The interior LED light is very nice.Things I wish it had / improvements needed:*A light that stays on that says whether the dishes inside are clean or dirty (something that's very useful when you have multiple family members using it). The outside timer only stays illuminated 10 minutes after completion.*A more easily removable silverware tray. I prefer a basket to this (it does have a miniscule basket if wanted) because you can take the silverware to the drawer, instead of carrying them all out. Perhaps the slide out tray cleans them better / is more space efficient.*For the buttons to lock out if the door is open all the way. Otherwise your legs bump the buttons as you're loading / unloading.*My huge gripe and the reason for the low rating: To have the Rinse, tub clean, 1/2 load, eco, delay wash cycle, or tub clean available via another method than the app. They did not give any way to do this, not even via complicated button presses. The app requires your dishwasher to connect to Wi-Fi, and access the internet. However, Bosch does not have any guaranteed security updates for the app or the device itself. Anybody familiar with internet connected devices knows that once they lose support, they become security risks and maybe even cease to function. This device would not need to be in that case, if there was another way to access these functions. Otherwise, it seems like planned obsolescence is the goal. The lifespan of this unit may be limited by its software support.*WPA3 support*The power button is not responsive and it makes you think you haven't pushed it. Button presses aren't responsive in general at times. It seems like it's using a slow processor or something. Kind of strange that Pong from 1972 was more responsive.*Plastic stuff on the top rack gets blown off pretty easily. There are some adjustments for the lower rack you can do in the app, but not the upper. Conversely, I am glad the upper rack is nice and powerful at cleaning, compared to my old unit.*A manual way to see the rinse aid level. The only indication it's low is through the app.
